thread:
oliver: Hey @eng-platform @eng-infra @sec-team quick ping for PR review — runtime PR #15432 changes KV cache eviction backoff and adds a routing header used by the router. Need approvals to merge during tomorrow's low-traffic window. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/15432

maya: quick heads-up: platform needs to confirm header name + rollout config. cc @tess :eyes:

tess: looking now. I have two tiny comments on the config schema. Can we add a canary flag? If not, we should schedule a 1h canary.

sam: infra ok on resource/capacity side, but this header touches proxy routing rules — security needs to sign off before we merge.

zoe: assigning to myself. I'll run the threat-surface checklist and proxy rule impact. ETA ~2h. Can you paste the header name and an example request with it?

oliver: sure — header and example below:

```
Header: X-RW-Route: evict-on-high-memory
Request example:
POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.internal
X-RW-Route: evict-on-high-memory
Content-Type: application/json
{"prompt": "test", "max_tokens": 64}
```

zoe: thanks. Quick read — nothing immediately risky, but please add a validation test for header format and a short docs note describing allowed values. Once tests/docs are in, I can give security approval.

maya: I can add the doc and a pytest unit that asserts header validation and fallback behavior. ETA by 15:00 UTC. If zoe approves after that, can we target the 16:00-17:00 UTC merge window?

tess: :thumbsup: if maya adds the test/docs I'll re-review and sign off from platform side.

sre-bot: Reminder: approved low-traffic deploy window tomorrow 16:00-17:00 UTC — merges during window will auto-schedule.

sam: SGTM. Once security approves and platform re-reviews, ping me and I'll queue the merge in the window.

oliver: thanks team — I'll watch for the PR updates. I'll push the test/docs change in ~45m and ping when ready.
